ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $AD \parallel EB \parallel FC$, $AB = 2BC$, $DF = 6$. What is the length of $DE$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution}: Since $AD\parallel EB\parallel FC$ and $AB=2BC$,\\
it follows that $\frac{DE}{EF}=\frac{AB}{BC}$. Therefore, $\frac{DE}{EF}=\frac{2BC}{BC}=2$,\\
Given $DF=DE+EF=6$,\\
it results in $DE=\boxed{4}$.
